principles.title: Data is never instructions.
principles.body: Every service I build hands the model what a person said as a claim with provenance, not as a command. Four of the LUCY services make that an ADR with a test behind it.

principles.title: The sandbox is the feature.
principles.body: Environments-api is remote code execution as a product, so path containment, PID ownership and sandbox tiers come first and the polish comes after.

principles.title: Every gate, everywhere.
principles.body: Lint, types, imports and tests at 100% branch coverage, the same four checks in every family repository, with a parity script that notices when one drifts.

experience.title: AI Engineer
experience.summary: Architected and delivered Jigsaw Intelligence: a production multi-agent system on Azure that lets people query and change complex business diagrams in plain language.
points: A worklist orchestrator that coordinates more than 30 tools within WebRTC packet-size limits
A structured variable and template pipeline that keeps the model's context small
Deterministic search tools that hand the model structured data to reason over
A workflow engine with parallel, sequential and conditional steps, streaming results as they arrive
Fixed a live WebRTC connectivity issue that was blocking the AI in a client's enterprise environment
Delivered in seven months and shown as the Hero product at the British Legal Technology Forum
